commits.subject: feat(pbta): lay the Urban Shadows booklet out in the contract rows
fix(harness): give the obsidian stubs getLanguage now that i18n imports it
fix(pbta): draw the Urban Shadows advancement Circles as ticks, not values
feat(pbta): word the Urban Shadows playbook through the interface language
feat(pbta): lay out the Urban Shadows harm tracker and scars as printed
fix(pbta): outrank the pack list lozenge on Urban Shadows check, lozenge and frame lists
fix(pbta): remove the stray lozenge bullet before Urban Shadows check lines
style(pbta): set Urban Shadows action titles in the pack display font
feat(pbta): leave the Urban Shadows creation column out and give debts blank lines
fix(pbta): drop the native bullet under the Urban Shadows lozenge and check markers
feat(pbta): draw Urban Shadows creation questions as name and property lines
feat(pbta): draw an Urban Shadows playbook as a two-face booklet
